name: mightling
description: Mightling local delegation plugin for Claude Code (Phase P1: class W1 watch tool, no model).

node.title: Mightling node
node.description: Optional Mightling node name or id (unused while only W1 is built: watch is loopback-only).

max_parallel.title: Maximum parallel tasks
max_parallel.description: Maximum concurrent delegated tasks (default 2; unused while only W1 is built).

allow_classes.title: Enabled delegation classes
allow_classes.description: Comma-separated enabled delegation classes (Phase P1 supports W1 only).
